main_body: Sci-fi building: a wide blue-grey sloped roof with two skylights, an orange eave band, and a front wall with four windows and a central door
top_band: Light blue-grey roof slope (#a3b4cb, #8396b2, #667896) from rows 1-16 in the x=32 column, closed at the front by a pale edge line at row 17 (#c3cad2)
evidence: The roof is a large, clearly lighter sloped surface (rows 1-16) with skylights and panel seams. It ends in a pale front-edge line at row 17, then a dark row at 18 and an orange eave band at rows 19-23 that shades the wall. The front face runs from about row 24 to 44. The windows have dark inset frames, and the door is drawn recessed with a dark interior. No receding side face is drawn. Top slope and front face are both clearly drawn, so it reads as a correct 3/4 building.

style.evidence: The roof has a ramp of about 6 steps (#a3b4cb, #8396b2, #667896, #4f5f7a, #3b475e, #1c2230) plus panel seams and skylight details. The outlines are dark blue-tinted (0% near-neutral edge pixels), not black stickers. The median of 9 colours per tile is close to the stone reference (11) and lower than the first reference (18). Flat-fill coverage is only 4%, and the wall panels have rivet dots, seams and highlights. The total of 28 colours is far below the references (185 and 66), but this is a small piece with a locked palette, and its structure and shading are acceptable beside the reference.
